t: You're outside HM Prison Wandsworth, a Category B men's prison in south-west London. It is run by His Majesty's Prison Service and is one of the largest prisons in the UK. Several well-known prisoners died here. They include William Joyce, nicknamed Lord Haw-Haw, a Nazi propaganda broadcaster, and John Amery, who founded the British Free Corps. Serial killers John Haigh, the Acid Bath Murderer, and George Chapman, the Borough Poisoner, also died here, as did Kate Webster. So did Derek Bentley, hanged as an accomplice to the murder of a policeman, a case that remains highly controversial.
